text:
Rina: Quick sync 1: new ISV wants marketplace listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. They requested a fully scripted bootstrap (IAM + images), guidance for branding, and explicit SKU->billing map. Who picks this up?
Alex: I can own the infrastructure templates (CFN + TF + GCP). Will standardize role/service-account names: redwood-pub-<slug>-svc for AWS, redwood-pub-<slug>-sa for GCP, and publisher-<slug>-svc for Azure.
Ben: For images: do we publish official AMIs/VMs or allow BYO? If BYO we'll need signed manifests + verification step.
Rina: ISV prefers we publish official AMIs for AWS but BYO for Azure/GCP is ok. We'll require signed manifest for BYO.
Clara (Legal): Legal intake mandatory before listing. If they request EU-only residency, add DPA + SCCs. Also no superlative marketing claims without signoff. Intake URL: https://redwood.internal/legal/publisher-intake
Diego: Azure needs Offer ID + publisher tenant early. I'll prepare an offer manifest template with required metadata and SKU mapping fields. Also note: Azure wants image URIs in VHD format if we publish a VM.
Alex: CFN snippet I'll drop in repo, example:```yaml
Resources:
  PublisherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: redwood-pub-${TenantSlug}-svc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement: [{/* trust policy */}]
```
Ben: GCP sample commands to include: `gcloud iam service-accounts create redwood-pub-<slug>` and `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding` examples. We'll also add Storage role bindings for image hosting.
Rina: Branding constraints: PNG 240x80 or SVG (max 2MB), alt text required, short blurb <= 280 chars. We'll build portal validation + preview.
Alex: Will add README explaining role rotation, least-privilege policies, and an automated onboarding script that accepts tenant slug and cloud targets.
Diego: I'll also add a checklist entry for publishing AMIs: snapshot ID, region list, and signed manifest.
Clara (Legal): Processing time: legal intake turnaround ~48-72h. If EU-only, expect an extra week for DPA routing.
marketplace-bot: Onboarding task created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/pub-1749955555 4dd Steps: create roles, upload branding, provide image manifests, legal intake, map SKUs.
Rina: Action items: Alex CFN+GCP templates by EOD tomorrow; Diego Azure manifest + offer metadata template by Wednesday; Ben to draft image verification checklist. Clara will watch for intake submission.
Ben: Will prototype a small verification script that checks manifest signature + image checksums and post to repo by Friday.
Alex: Noted. I'll also include TF modules for customers who prefer runnable IaC.
Rina: Great. If anyone hits blockers, post here and tag me. We'll schedule a 15-min call if we need to unblock cross-functional items. :rocket:
